conclusion.label: BARE-EQUIVALENT-OBSERVED
conclusion.interpretation: Both arms passed all eight preregistered scenarios. The Core did not materially lower unjustified agreement or reversal because Bare had no such failures. The overlay adds prompt input tokens, but single-run wall time and output-token differences are not evidence of material friction.
conclusion.recommendation: Do not claim behavioral superiority or add further Core clauses. Removing the runtime Core is a reasonable minimalism option, but changing the approved product scope or personal installation is not an automatic small fix.
